shared_elements: circular/disc motifs associated with the head or upper body
justification: The most specific correspondence is that both present a highly stylized frontal anthropomorphic form with prominent circular motifs and linear/geometric detailing on or around the body. The biggest difference is that A is a complex active figure with limbs, staff, headdress, wing-like or feathered elements and multiple surrounding ornaments, while B is a much more abstract block-like face/body with a few circles and curved bands and no comparable held objects, pose, or surrounding iconographic scheme.
